request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target Image 1: existing Ruan Xiaoqi body-only four-direction IDLE atlas. Reference Image 2: unchanged separate cart atlas, only a mechanical reference for the handle positions; DO NOT include the cart in the output.
Task: refine only the forearms and gripping hands so the figure naturally grips the fixed cart handles after the two images are layered. Keep the four existing full bodies, same 2x2 order, same native square canvas and scale, same head/torso/hips/feet positions, direction and light. Do not redesign the man or his stance.
Layout: upper left SE/front facing lower-right, upper right SW/front facing lower-left, lower left NE/rear facing upper-right, lower right NW/rear facing upper-left.
Precise local changes relative to the target atlas: SE move the lower-left-on-screen near grip slightly down-left (~14 px left,26 px down on the 1254px source), and the upper-right far grip slightly up-right (~14px right,26px up). Extend/bend each forearm anatomically to those positions, keep shoulder positions. SW move the upper-left far grip slightly up-left (~14px left,13px up) and lower-right near grip slightly down-right (~14px right,13px down). NE extend the visible near forearm modestly toward lower-right (~19px right,19px down); the far hand bends around the far handle behind the torso and should be naturally occluded, remove the distracting spare fist beside his waist. NW extend the visible near forearm slightly down-left (~25px left,26px down); far hand bends to the far handle and is occluded by the body, remove the distracting spare fist at the waist. All visible hands must look like gently curled fingers holding a wooden shaft, rather than two punching fists, with coherent wrists/thumbs.
Invariants: same rough-featured adult man with prominent eyes, uneven pale yellow beard, black topknot, naturally scattered dark skin spots, shirtless jujube merchant disguise, plain pale apron, grey waist sash and rolled grey trousers, bare feet. No scars/tattoos added. Same painterly RPG detail and warm light. This continues the Water Margin chapter16 disguise; no new narrative.
Output ONLY the four character sprites in the same 2x2 arrangement on genuine transparent alpha; generous separation and fully intact crown, knuckles and feet. No cart, shafts, floor/shadow, opaque background, guide dots, arrows, numbers, labels, watermark or extra figures.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied four-direction Ruan Xiaoqi body-only sprite atlas.
Primary request: Fix the atlas packing ONLY. Keep the four figures and their existing new arm/hand designs, but make EACH complete figure smaller WITHIN ITS OWN quadrant so there is at least 45 pixels of fully transparent padding on all four sides of every quadrant in a roughly1254 square output. In particular, neither top-row feet may touch/cross the horizontal centerline, and neither bottom-row topknot may touch/cross that line. Keep all toes and knuckles intact. Four evenly sized cells in an exact 2x2 grid; each body crown-to-lowest-foot fits comfortably inside its cell. Aim for character height about500px per627px cell, not600px.
Invariants: Same SE/SW/NE/NW order as input, same body proportions, same natural dark skin spots, rough face, pale uneven beard, topknot, shirtless torso, pale apron, grey sash, rolled grey trousers and bare feet. Keep the SE/SW two curled gripping hands; keep NE/NW far hand naturally hidden behind torso instead of a spare fist at the waist. Preserve the painterly shading and animation-ready body-only content. Do not crop or amputate the figures to achieve spacing.
Output genuine transparent alpha, exactly FOUR complete sprites, no cart/handles, no floor/shadow, no drawn grid, lines, labels, duplicate limbs or background.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: body-only four-view CONTACT A walk sprite atlas for the same Ruan Xiaoqi pushing a separate loaded cart.
Input roles: Image1 gives the current SE and SW CONTACT A bodies/leg steps (use its top row). Image2 gives the current NE and NW CONTACT A bodies/leg steps (use its bottom row). Image3 is the improved IDLE hand/forearm/occlusion design to carry into this walking phase; it is not a reference for static idle legs. Image4 is the separate cart, mechanical reference only, not to be included.
Task: retain the source CONTACT A stride in each specified direction, rework the forearms and hands to the improved loaded-cart grip posture from Image3. SE/SW show two natural curved grips, not punching fists; wrists coherent and forearms supported. NE/NW show the visible near hand reaching to its handle, while far hand/arm reaches behind the torso and is naturally occluded; no spare visible fist at the waist. Retain authentic opposite front/rear perspective and anatomically normal slow pushing stride, NOT an idle stance.
Invariants: same rough-featured adult with prominent eyes, pale uneven beard, naturally scattered skin spots and black topknot, shirtless chapter16 jujube merchant disguise; pale cloth apron, grey sash and rolled grey pants, bare feet, painterly RPG detail and same lighting. Keep head/torso build, phase-A leg placement and stance from their assigned source quadrants; no new props or narrative.
Composition: exact 2x2 square atlas: SE upper-left, SW upper-right, NE lower-left, NW lower-right. Each COMPLETE figure is comfortably centered inside its quadrant; crown-to-lowest-foot height about500px per627px cell, with at least40px transparent padding on EVERY side of EVERY cell. Do not enlarge sprites to touch or cross the central row/column lines. No clipping/amputation. Output genuine alpha transparency, ONLY four character sprites, no cart/handles, floor/shadow, grid/labels/guide marks or background.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target Image1: the new CONTACT A four-view sprite atlas. Image2: correct existing CONTACT A rear-arm direction, use its BOTTOM ROW for mechanical arm orientation only.
Change ONLY the forearms of the bottom two rear-view sprites in Image1. Their current elbows/knuckles are too high and arms too bent as if holding bicycle handlebars. These must be long, softly bent, downward-reaching cart-pushing arms.
Bottom-left NE: preserve shoulder and stance, extend the visible near arm diagonally DOWN-RIGHT from the shoulder until its curled gripping hand is about level with the LOW edge of the waist sash, outside the silhouette to the right, matching the reach in Image2 bottom-left. Far hand remains completely occluded behind torso, no second fist at waist.
Bottom-right NW: mirror the reach in perspective, extend visible near arm diagonally DOWN-LEFT to the low edge of the waist sash, outside the silhouette to the left, matching Image2 bottom-right reach. Far hand stays naturally hidden.
Keep ALL other pixels/design as close as possible: top two SE/SW figures, head/torso/pelvis/cloth/legs/feet of bottom two, correct CONTACT A stride, body scale, perspective, rough face, prominent eyes/pale uneven beard/natural skin spots/topknot, shirtless merchant disguise, pale apron/grey sash/rolled pants/bare feet, painterly shading. Do not change knees/stride to idle. Keep transparent gutters, all four full figures isolated inside their2x2 cells; no touching/crossing cell boundaries. Genuine transparent alpha, no cart, handles, floor/shadow, guides, labels or extra figures.

canon: Existing chapter15 rough face/prominent eyes/pale uneven beard/natural dark spots and chapter16 shirtless merchant. Apron/sash/topknot/rolled trousers/bare feet, camera/precise grips and cart structure are conservative art interpretation; no new plot, abilities or outcome.
observations: Initial source rejected: strong alpha crosses the horizontal cell boundary in all four views.
Padded variant is candidate only; requested45px padding is not claimed achieved; actual per-cell bounds are recorded.
Rear far fist removed at waist to follow occlusion behind torso. Exact far-hand contact under occlusion is not proved.
Two front grip points still need native assembly comparison. No final grip/gait/body-continuity acceptance.
CONTACT A first source rejected: rear arms too high/bent; SW feet also cross into NW cell. No view from this source adopted.
CONTACT A correction uses only NE/NW rear views; forearms reach downward and waist fist stays occluded. Front views change stride and are deliberately not selected.
Current proposed scope: four idle views and rear NE/NW CONTACT A only; other eighteen poses and fixed cart remain unchanged. Full hand/walk/body continuity remains open.
